manifest.name: dsh-serena
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness profile bundle: Serena MCP integration — symbolic code intelligence via serena-agent, plus the Claude Code hooks bridge for project activation and tool-usage reminders

bundle.text:
# dsh-serena profile bundle patch: Serena MCP server + Claude Code hooks bridge as
# HOST-plane rows. After the host restarts, every agent and preset on the profile
# sees mcp__serena__* tools.
#
# Row 1 — the Serena MCP server (stdio). Command resolution:
#   1. SERENA_COMMAND environment variable, if set (absolute path to a serena
#      executable) — use this for custom venv installs;
#   2. otherwise `serena` from PATH — the default after the official install:
#        uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
#      (requires uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)
#
#   Windows note (Smart App Control / WDAC machines): such policies may block
#   uv-managed unsigned Python builds. Workaround used by the author — build a
#   venv from a trusted signed interpreter and point SERENA_COMMAND at it:
#     python -m venv "%USERPROFILE%\.local\serena-venv"
#     %USERPROFILE%\.local\serena-venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install serena-agent
#     setx SERENA_COMMAND "%USERPROFILE%\.local\serena-venv\Scripts\serena.exe"
#
# Flags:
#   --context claude-code       hides tools DSH already has (read/shell/search) and
#                               keeps only Serena's symbolic tools; single-project mode
#   --project-from-cwd          auto-activates the session workspace as the project
#   --open-web-dashboard False  don't pop a browser tab on startup
- insert:
    - id: mcp-serena
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: serena
        transport: stdio
        command: !!js "(process.env.SERENA_COMMAND || 'serena')"
        args: ['start-mcp-server', '--context', 'claude-code', '--project-from-cwd', '--open-web-dashboard', 'False']
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
        failOnStartupError: false
    - id: dsh-hooks-claude-code
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
      config:
        configPath: !!js "((process.env.USERPROFILE || process.env.HOME || '') + '/.dsh/hooks.json')"
# Row 2 — the Claude Code-compatible hooks bridge (dependency of this bundle),
# inserted together with Row 1 above (new rows must use `insert`).
# Loads hooks.json from the DSH home directory (%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\hooks.json on
# Windows, ~/.dsh/hooks.json elsewhere), which runs serena-hooks (activate /
# remind / cleanup) on session start, before tool calls, and at stop. The file
# must exist; if it is missing the bridge logs a warning and registers no hooks.
# Create it per the README — commands call serena-hooks by absolute path if it is
# not on PATH.

readme.text:
[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-serena)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent gains IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence — `find_symbol`, `find_referencing_symbols`, `rename_symbol`, `replace_symbol_body`, `get_symbols_overview` and more — via the [Serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) MCP server, plus session hooks that keep agents actually using it.

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles API); Windows/macOS/Linux; Python ≥ 3.11 for the Serena CLI

readme.section: What it adds to every agent on the profile
readme.text:
| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp-serena` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | Spawns the Serena MCP server (stdio) → `mcp__serena__*` tools: symbol search & overview, find references/implementations/declarations, rename & safe-delete symbols, symbolic editing, per-project memories, diagnostics |
| `dsh-hooks-claude-code` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` (dependency of this bundle) | Runs `~/.dsh/hooks.json`: session-start project activation prompt, tool-drift reminders toward Serena's tools, stop cleanup |

readme.section: What it adds to every agent on the profile
readme.text: Launched with `--context claude-code --project-from-cwd`: each session auto-activates its workspace as the Serena project, and tools that duplicate DSH built-ins (file read/search/shell) stay hidden.

**One command (recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-serena
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-serena`.

1. **The Serena CLI** — the official install puts `serena` on your PATH (the bundle's default):
   ```bash
   # install uv first: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/
   uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
   ```
   Custom location? Point the bundle at it:
   ```powershell
   setx SERENA_COMMAND "C:\path\to\serena.exe"
   ```
   > **Windows note (Smart App Control / WDAC):** application-control policies may block uv-managed unsigned Python builds. Workaround: build a venv from a trusted/signed interpreter, `pip install serena-agent` into it, and `setx SERENA_COMMAND` to that venv's `serena.exe`.
2. **The hooks file** `~/.dsh/hooks.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\hooks.json`) — copy [`hooks.template.json`](./hooks.template.json):
   ```json
   {
     "SessionStart": [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks activate --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "PreToolUse":    [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks remind --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "Stop":          [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks cleanup --client=claude-code" }] }]
   `serena-hooks` ships
Then **restart DeepSeek Harness**. Verify by asking an agent: *"activate this project with serena"*.

- Spawns a local `serena` MCP server process (language servers may download per-language tooling on demand)
- Reads/writes only your activated project workspaces; memories stored per-project in `.serena/`
- No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry

- The hooks-bridge dependency is version-pinned (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` `0.2.0-rc.2`); if your DSH runtime is newer and install is rejected for peer incompatibility, match the version to your runtime
- First symbol query in a new project downloads that language's language server — first call can be slow
Remove `dsh-serena` from the profile `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies` (or `dsh plugin remove`), then restart the host. The Serena CLI, venv and hooks file are independent of the bundle.
Upstream: [oraios/serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) (MIT / GPL-3.0) — this bundle only wires it into DeepSeek Harness.
